[REPUBLIC AcT No. 12089]

AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN INTEGRATED SCHOOL IN
CIUDAD DE STRIKE, BARANGAY MOLINO I, CITY OF
BACOOR, PROVINCE OF CAVITE TO BE KNOWN AS
THE CIUDAD DE STRIKE INTEGRATED SCHOOL,
AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR

Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the Philippines in
Congress assembled:

SECTION 1. There is hereby established, under the supervision
of the Department of Education, an integrated school in Ciudad de
Strike, Barangay Molino I, City of Bacoor, Province of Cavite to be
known as the Ciudad de Strike Integrated School.

SEC. 2. The Secretary of Education shall immediately include
in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Ciudad de
Strike Integrated School, the funding of which shall be included in
the annual General Appropriations Act.
 
%

SEC. 3. Within ninety (90) days from the approval of this Act,
the Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations
implementing the provisions of this Act. Such implementing rules
and regulations shall provide for the school’s organization,
administration, operations and management, in accordance with
Republic Act No. 9155, or the “Governance of Basic Education Act
of 2001”, Republic Act No. 10533, or the “Enhanced Basic Education
Act of 2013”, and other basic education-related laws,

Suc. 4. This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after
its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of

general circulation.
Approved,
FRANCIS “CHIZ” G, ESCUDERO EOLA hoon
President of the Senate Speaker of the House

of Representatives

This Act, which originated in the House of Representatives,
was passed by the House of Representatives and the Senate of the
Philippines on May 15, 2024 and August 28, 2024, respectively.
